name: Wastewater treatment (API separators, DAF, biological, MBR)
principle: Refinery effluent passes through an API gravity separator, then dissolved air flotation with coagulant and polymer, and usually biological treatment; a membrane bioreactor (MBR) is the high-quality option. A 2023 study of the Kawrgosk refinery measured API at about 17 to 18% oil and grease removal and DAF at 85 to 86%, giving about 90% combined, and modelled MBR at above 90% COD removal.

process_steps.name: Dissolved air flotation with coagulant and polymer

performance.metric: oil and grease removal, API separator then DAF
performance.basis: Kawrgosk refinery data March to June 2022; API 17 to 18%, DAF 85 to 86%; treated O&G below 50 mg/L

source.note: The Cost Benefit of Refinery Effluent Pretreatment Upstream of Membrane Bioreactors (PMC10456940); Kawrgosk refinery data 2022

advantages: API plus DAF is a low-energy, low-cost pretreatment (about one sixth of MBR net present value in the study)
limitations: The study's MBR numbers are projections
